verdict.rationale: Trello documents generic AI help for writing or editing content and an MCP server that connects Trello to any AI tool. That suggests an external AI could read board data and draft an update, but nothing shows a built-in feature that summarizes recent activity into a status report. Missing for 10: native AI status-update or summary generation from board or card activity, documentation of activity-based summarization, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
